# FG-AUTH-0023

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unparseable_or_unsupported_ssh_key_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: SSH 公開鍵を登録できません。Ed25519 か ECDSA の公開鍵（ssh-ed25519 AAAA… の 1 行）を貼り付けてください。
- en: The SSH public key cannot be added. Paste one Ed25519 or ECDSA public key line (ssh-ed25519 AAAA…).
- id: Kunci publik SSH tidak dapat ditambahkan. Tempelkan satu baris kunci publik Ed25519 atau ECDSA (ssh-ed25519 AAAA…).

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C13 (ADR-0033 §2): `POST /api/v1/user/ssh-keys` refused the key. `reason`: `malformed` (not `<algorithm> <base64> [comment]` on one line, base64 that does not decode, a key blob that does not match its algorithm or has trailing bytes; `detail` names which), `algorithm_unsupported` (`algorithm`: RSA, DSA, security-key and certificate types are not accepted — Ed25519 and ECDSA P-256 / P-384 / P-521 only), `too_long` (the line is longer than 8 KiB), `title_invalid` (empty, more than 100 characters, a control or invisible format character), `duplicate` (the same key — by its SHA-256 fingerprint — is already registered, to this user or to another: a key identifies one person; whose is never said), `limit` (the user already has 50 keys), `owner_disabled` (the account is not active). Nothing is written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One info log line with `error_code=FG-AUTH-0023`, `request_id`, `reason`, `user` and, when known, `fingerprint` and `algorithm`. The user's keys: SELECT id, title, algorithm, fingerprint_sha256, created_at FROM forge.user_ssh_keys WHERE user_id = <id>.

## 対処 (fix)

Generate an Ed25519 key (`ssh-keygen -t ed25519`) and paste the contents of the `.pub` file. `duplicate`: the user already registered it (see the list) or shares a key with someone — every person needs their own key. `limit`: delete keys that are no longer used.
